verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe exactly this story. After a brief scoping exchange, Marlin works autonomously for up to about eight hours, repeatedly forming hypotheses, navigating the web, resolving contradictions and comparing hypotheses across thousands of cycles. It then delivers a referenced report of up to 100 pages and is explicitly framed as doing 'more than summarize'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence, including the customer quotes, comes from Sakana's own pages).
